messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Dawn. The year is 1750, and the world turns slowly under a canopy of wood and wind, for the invention of the steam engine remains a mere toy of curious minds, and the canals of Europe carry only grain and timber, while the great cities of London and Paris still rely on the muscle of draft horses and the breath of sailors. Dawn.
Sail. By 1850, the oceans are still ruled by the whisper of canvas and the creak of rope, as no ironclad warship has yet shattered the wooden walls of empires, and the telegraph wire has never been strung across the continents to stitch the globe into a single nervous system, leaving every port a silent island of local lore. Sail.
Coal. The year is 1950, and the night sky still holds its ancient, undimmed stars, for no smokestack has ever pierced the clouds with the soot of industry, and the world's energy is drawn entirely from the turning of the earth and the falling of the rain, keeping humanity tethered to the soil and the seasons. Coal.
Wheel. The twenty-first century dawns in a world of polished stone and soaring spires, where the airships of the aerostatists carry silk and spices across the wind currents, and the academies of Alexandria and Kyoto debate the nature of the universe with abacuses and astrolabes, forever bound to the slow, deliberate pace of the hand. Wheel.
